name: Clinical Mediation Drill - Patient Words to Team Words
_note: Skill drill focused on mediation: adapting information between patient-friendly English, chart English, and team handover English.

anchors.90-100: Clear, accurate sentences in every register
anchors.70-80: Minor errors only; meaning always clear
anchors.50-60: Some errors but message remains understandable

anchors.90-100: Preserves clinical meaning exactly while changing register
anchors.70-80: Mostly accurate; minor loss of nuance
anchors.50-60: Some details lost or softened too much
anchors.10-20: Meaning transfer is unsafe or misleading

anchors.90-100: Adapts smoothly among patient, chart, nurse/team, and attending language
anchors.30-40: Often uses the wrong register for the listener

anchors.90-100: Concise, fluent, and easy to follow
Consistently respects what each listener needs to know
anchors.50-60: Sometimes too technical or too vague

checklist.item: converted patient lay description into concise clinical/team language
converted clinical jargon back into patient-friendly language
preserved key numbers, timings, symptoms, and risk details
used signposting to show which listener the version was for
checked understanding when speaking to a patient or family member
